sentences.text: 3. When the Coordinate Bench judgments were confronted to the advocate appearing for the Petitioners on record, who himself had argued one of those cases earlier, he seeks leave to withdraw the Petitions offering unconditional apology.

sentences.text: This Court having noticed a kind of culpable conduct on the part of the arguing counsel Mr.Suresh K, wanted to refer the matter to the Karnataka State Bar Council for disciplinary action.
sentences._hearing_file: Sri. Krishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. On solicitation, a few tall members of the Bar namely Smt. Shilpa Shah (Sr. Panel Counsel for NHAI), Mr.K.Krishna (Sr. Panel Counsel for BDA), Prof. Lakshmeesh Rao (Sr. Panel Counsel for BDA) & Mr.R.Srinivasa Gowda (AGA) suggested that instead of referring the matter to the Bar Council, the advocate for the Petitioners may be let after administering a censure and that he be asked to undergo counselling.
sentences._hearing_file: Sri. Krishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 March, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Accordingly, this court censured him, with a direction to undergo counselling for one hour each at the law chambers of Prof. Lakshmeesh Rao, Mr.K.Krishna &
Smt.Shilpa Shah, after taking prior appointment in the next four weeks and to show to the Registrar General of this Court the Certificates of Counselling issued by them.
sentences._hearing_file: Sri. Krishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: While making this order, the fair opinion of learned Advocate appearing for the respondent-Housing Society Mr.K.R.Krishna Murthy is also noted.
sentences._hearing_file: Sri. Krishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. The above lenient view having been taken, leave as sought for, has been accorded to the Petitioners to withdraw both the petitions.

sentences.text: Ordered accordingly & Writ Petitions are disposed off, costs having been reluctantly made easy.

sentences.text: The Registrar General of this Court shall ensure compliance of the instructions issued to the advocate on record namely Mr.Suresh K.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
1. The case of the petitioner is that his land in Survey No.45/1 measuring 1 acre 33 guntas of Byradenahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bangalore Rural District, was acquired for the purpose of respondent no.2/Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board.
Further,
respondent no.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
He prays that consent award be passed in respect of the said land.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioner produces all the relevant documents to show that he is the Sri. Krishnappa vs The State Of Karnataka on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67667822/
2 owner of the property.
opennyai_summary.issue: 3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: There is NC: 2024:KHC:19023 no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
